item.description:

I'm a passionate software developer working on Open-Source software projects since 2003. I started out at Sourceforge with file-sharing projects. In the mean time I worked on disk encryption software. And later I moved to GitHub starting an other novel file-sharing project. Nowadays I resumed making useful tools for windows 10, allowing users to take back control of their computers.
